title: Effects of Gum Arabic Ingestion on Hormonal and Metabolic Changes in Patients With Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
brief_summary: To assess the effects on hormonal and metabolic changes in the PCOs patients after ingestion of Arabic gum
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are diagnosed with PCO by independent Gynecologist

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diabetic patients
* Menopausal women
* History of allergy to Gum Arabic
